scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix frontend install --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix backend install --no-audit --no-fund
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.check:backend: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix backend run build
scripts.check:frontend: npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.check: npm run check:backend && npm run check:frontend
scripts.docker:restart: docker compose down && docker compose up --build
